description: Creates a new field mapping for an entity (e.g. 'Journal Entry', 'Bill', 'Invoice'). Look up valid target fields with get_fields first. Returns the created mapping including its id.

entityName.description: Entity this mapping targets — must match list_entities output (e.g. 'Journal Entry').

fields.description: Field mappings. Each entry maps a CSV column or a constant to an Importer target field.

items.description: One mapped field. Either map a CSV column via 'sourceFieldTitle' or pin a constant via 'fixedValue' — not both.

fixedValue.description: Constant value applied to every row (string, number, or boolean).

sourceFieldTitle.description: CSV column header to read from.

targetFieldId.description: Importer field id from get_fields for the target entity.

name: create_mapping

fixedValue.description: Constant applied to every row, if not mapped from a column.

sourceFieldTitle.description: CSV column the field reads from.
